_comment: Declarative model registry for model.gateway. The gateway resolves a requested model (by -Model id, -Tier alias, or the default) against `models`, and runs it if `wired` and its type/engine are supported (MVP: type=llm via engine=llama-server). Non-wired / non-LLM entries are DECLARED so later modules can wire them without rediscovering the machine. Paths point at PORTABLE STAGED COPIES under _pending-model-storage (decoupled from the obsolete source folders). To swap which model a tier uses, change `tiers`/`defaults` below — no code change.

engines._comment: Staged, verified to run standalone (health + chat) 2026-07-24. Depends on a system CUDA runtime (not on the source folder). If torn down, restage from F:\Qwen3.5-27B\llama.cpp\build\bin.

models.name: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
models.notes: Fastest; smoke tests / trivial labeling. Fully GPU-offloaded on the RTX 2080 Ti.

models.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
models.notes: Default weak tier: bulk classification/labeling/extraction. Fully GPU-offloaded.

models.name: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct
models.notes: Mid tier: harder labeling; still fully GPU-offloaded.

models.name: Qwen3.5-27B
models.notes: Strong tier: review/adjudication (Module 9). ~16 GB Q4 > 11 GB VRAM, so PARTIAL GPU offload. Tuned by Module 9 (2026-07-24): swept gpu_layers {20,28,36} on an idle GPU — all loaded (no OOM), throughput monotonic 1.43/1.67/1.93 tok/s; raised 28 -> 32 (strictly fewer layers than the 36 that fit, so it fits with headroom for desktop display VRAM). Cold first load ~90s (16 GB read from F:), warm ~7-9s (OS cache); callers should pass a longer load timeout for a cold strong load (review.processor -LoadTimeoutSec). Still slow (~2 tok/s) — reserve for the hardest items.

models.name: Whisper base.en (ggml)
models.notes: DECLARED only. Wire in Module 11 (speech.stt). whisper.cpp CLI (CUDA + CPU builds) exists on this machine.

models.notes: DECLARED only. Shared speech tokenizer used by the Qwen3-TTS voices (also bundled inside each voice's speech_tokenizer/ — see REVIEW_QUEUE re: triplication). Wire in Module 12 (speech.tts).
